scripts.api: npm run build:packages && node packages/cli/dist/index.js proxy
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @echoregent/core && npm run build --workspace @echoregent/cli
scripts.pack:packages: npm run build:packages && npm pack --workspace @echoregent/core --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace @echoregent/cli --pack-destination artifacts
